meta.title: Haraka: bilingual invoice, VAT and tax templates for UAE businesses
meta.description: Excel and Word templates for UAE freelancers and small companies. FTA-compliant tax invoices, a VAT tracker, a corporate tax estimator, a cash-flow planner and bilingual contracts. Arabic and English in every file.

hero.sub: Bilingual Excel and Word templates built for UAE freelancers and small companies. Download, fill in, send.

lineup.sub: Every file shares the same fields, numbering and look, so a quotation becomes an invoice becomes a ledger line without retyping anything.

facts.h2: Built on the rules as they stand.

items.l: AED: mandatory VAT registration and the 0% corporate tax band
Corporate tax above AED 375,000 taxable income
E-invoicing becomes mandatory for smaller businesses

facts.note: Figures follow public Federal Tax Authority rules at the time of release. Pro subscribers receive updated files when a rule changes.

check.sub: Two numbers most owners get wrong. Enter your annual figures in AED.
check.vatBelow: Below the voluntary threshold. You may register from AED 187,500.
check.vatVoluntary: You may register voluntarily. Mandatory from AED 375,000.
check.ctRelief: Revenue is under AED 3M, so Small Business Relief may be available. If elected, tax payable is AED 0.
check.disclaimer: An estimate, not advice. The full estimator handles adjustments, free zone status and deadlines.

steps.p: Checkout takes a minute. The files arrive by email and open in Excel, Google Sheets, Numbers, Word or Google Docs.
Type your business details once on the Settings sheet. Every document picks them up, in both languages.
Export to PDF, or print to A4. Your client sees a clean bilingual document with every field the FTA expects.

pricing.sub: Buy a single template, or get everything and stay current.
pricing.secure: Secure checkout by Lemon Squeezy. Card, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Invoice issued automatically.
pricing.aed: Prices in AED are approximate; the card is charged in USD.

final.h2: Send your next invoice from Haraka.
final.sub: Five templates, both languages, one payment.
